gates.G1_sample: n >= 150 settled bets in the validation window
gates.G2_significance: full-sample p < 0.05 vs the vig-aware break-even AND Benjamini-Hochberg q < 0.10 across the whole programme (27 signals + 18 strategies)
gates.G3_consistency: discovery ROI > 0, validation ROI > 0, >= 55% of validation seasons positive
gates.G4_price_shock: validation ROI stays > 0 when every recorded price is 5 cents worse
gates.G5_drawdown: validation max drawdown <= 20u and no season > 40% of validation profit
gates.G7_coverage: >= 25 bets per season on average in the validation window
